verdicts.rationale: The POST /cluster/recover endpoint correctly returns HTTP 500 with error 'Qdrant is running in standalone mode' when Qdrant is not in cluster mode. This is intentional design: consensus_proposal_sender is None in standalone mode (src/main.rs:508-514), and get_consensus_proposal_sender explicitly checks for this condition and returns the exact error message (lib/storage/src/content_manager/toc/mod.rs:777). The cluster status endpoint confirms disabled status. This is expected API behavior, not a bug.
